four_rolls(banked: int, turn: int, opponent: int) -> bool =>
    turn < 16 /\ banked + turn < goal

    (name = "hold at 20", rolls_again = hold_at_20),

    (name = "four rolls a turn", rolls_again = four_rolls)
]

            if roll == 1 then

                if show then

                fi

                break
            fi
